verdict.rationale: cubic documents its own Analytics API, which returns PR-level data on flagged issues, fixes, and AI-authored code. That makes it a real public API, but it is scoped to reading analytics rather than driving the product, for example triggering reviews or changing configuration. Probes for an OpenAPI spec all returned 404. The MCP server's ability to request reviews belongs to the separate MCP story and is not credited here. Missing for 10: documented API endpoints for driving core actions (triggering reviews, fixes, settings), a published OpenAPI or reference spec, auth and rate-limit documentation, and independent hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can drive the product through a documented public API

citations.quote: The Analytics API gives you PR-level data on how many issues were flagged, how many were fixed, how much AI code was authored, etc.
